name: agro-popular-science-writer
description: Plan, research, draft and review referenced agricultural popular-science articles in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: A subject-first writing workspace that helps ChatGPT research evidence, suggest timely titles, recommend an editorial framework, format APA 7 references and produce an original popular-science article through chat and an interactive UI.
defaultPrompt: Plan a referenced article about an agricultural science topic
Suggest timely titles and the best writing framework
Check my evidence and APA 7 references before drafting
